limitations: Preserve original third-party notices; Relayune project licensing does not replace them.
No historical private repository, model-generation history or employment/IP assignments were consulted.
System fonts are not bundled; historical wordmark rasterization depends on local font resolution.
Generated placeholders are not product screenshots or acceptance evidence.
